prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG atlas for a 2D SIDE VIEW cutaway guild management game set in modern Seoul. Create one 2048x1024 image containing EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 equally sized cells, no gutters or labels. Each cell has a truly transparent background and contains ONE modular architectural sprite centered, nothing touches neighboring cells. Style: polished hand-painted anime game background art, warm cream office walls, deep navy steel beams with tiny screws, warm ceiling lights, subtle cyan glass, matching an SD character game; NOT pixel art, NOT medieval, no characters, no logos, no words or numbers. Orthographic SIDE VIEW, horizontal floors, no isometric view, no visible top-down perspective. Cells in reading order: row1 col1 a long continuous cream-tile corridor FLOOR platform, horizontal thin 5:1 aspect, dark navy structural underside, left and right ends perfectly flat seamless for horizontal repetition; row1 col2 a thin horizontal ceiling beam with warm inset lighting, flat seamless ends, 5:1 aspect; row1 col3 a narrow LEFT building exterior end wall steel column, tall 1:3 aspect; row1 col4 matching RIGHT end wall steel column, tall 1:3 aspect. Row2 col1 a tall modern office ELEVATOR open shaft/cabin front, 1:2 aspect, navy and brushed silver doorframe, glowing cyan call light, transparent open center with subtle cream interior but no people; row2 col2 a long flat navy modern rooftop cornice, thin 5:1 aspect, ends flat seamless; row2 col3 a low subtle front edge / railing of polished navy metal and transparent cyan glass, very thin 8:1 aspect with flat seamless ends, does not block characters; row2 col4 a tall modern glass building entrance doorway, 1:2 aspect, cream and navy metal frame, transparent door center. Fill shapes to approximately 90% of their cell width for horizontal strips and 85% of cell height for tall structures. Consistent crisp dark outlines, restrained texture, easy to crop each equal cell separately. Transparent alpha everywhere outside the sprites. This is a technical sprite sheet, do not arrange sprites into a complete building or add backgrounds.
